{{Quote|Hondo's got a private fleet, but only he knows where those ships are.|[[Gwarm/Legends|Gwarm]]|<ref name="A Necessary Bond">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref>}}
This '''secret hangar''' was where pirate Captain [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] stored some extra spaceships in case they would ever be needed. Only he knew the location of the hangar.

==History==
[[File:HondoSecretHangarExterior-ANB.png|thumb|left|250px|The entrance to the hidden vault]]
{{Quote|My new friend General Grievous has destroyed my ships."<br />"We know you have one, a whole pirate fleet!"<br />"And one of my old friends, apparently, has been talking too much. Ah! What does it matter? We'll never reach the vault anyway.|Hondo Ohnaka and [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], about his private hangar|<ref name="A Necessary Bond" />}}
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the cyborg [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] arrived on the planet of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] on orders from [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to finally take revenge against Ohnaka for [[Dooku Captured|taking him]] and [[The Gungan General|holding him for ransom]]. Ohnaka was imprisoned and saved by a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Professor [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Gwarm/Legends|Gwarm]], and [[Unidentified Weequay pirate 2/Legends|another pirate]] as their only means of escape from Grievous and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] was via one of Ohnaka's hidden ships. Together, Ohnaka, the Jedi, and his gang made an escape for the hangar and escaped the planet in the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']].

Throughout the course of Ohnaka's rule as leader of the Ohnaka Gang, he stored not only the ''Slave I'', but also other ships like the [[Fortune and Glory/Legends|''Fortune and Glory'']], a [[HCT-2001_Dragonboat-class_Reugeot_905_freighter/Legends|HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Freighter]], another [[Personal_Luxury_Yacht_3000/Legends|Luxury 3000 Yacht]], [[YV-666_light_freighter/Legends|YV-666]], four [[WLO-5_speeder_tank/Legends|WLO-5 tanks]] and six [[HH-87_Starhopper/Legends|HH-87 Starhoppers]] and possibly more.
